mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT SR.ROLE_KEY FROM sys_role SR LEFT JOIN sys_user_role sur on SR.ID = sur.ROLE_ID LEFT JOIN sys_user su on sur.USER_ID = su.ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND SUR.USER_ID = #{id} AND SR.LOGIC_DEL = false

SELECT DISTINCT R.ID, R.ROLE_NAME, R.ROLE_KEY, R.ORDER_NUM, R.DATA_SCOPE, R.MENU_CHECK_STRICTLY, R.DEPT_CHECK_STRICTLY, R.STATUS, R.LOGIC_DEL, R.CREATE_TIME, R.REMARK FROM sys_role R LEFT JOIN sys_user_role SUR ON R.ID = SUR.ROLE_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_USER U ON SUR.USER_ID = U.ID LEFT JOIN sys_dept D ON U.DEPT_ID = D.ID ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}
